title: Image size and security: unprivileged user and reduced surface

videos.script: Ana's image is small now, and it still runs as root. This lesson changes both of those defaults. {{root}} First, why root inside a container matters, when there are walls around it. It is not that root breaks out. It is that every mistake is worth more. {{user}} The fix is two lines: a base made for it, and a user written as a number. A port below a thousand and twenty four still works, and a folder needs handing over before the user can write to it. {{surface}} Then what is inside the base. Two Debian images with the same seventy eight packages, and very different sizes. {{layers}} And a trap: a file deleted in a later step is still in the image, and still downloaded on every pull.
